capabilities.name: titleCase
capabilities.where: test/title-case.test.js asserts exact output for ordinary words, small joining words, edge words, and whitespace; any change to src/titleCase.js makes it fail.

capabilities.name: query
capabilities.where: test/query.test.js asserts exact parse and format results including escapes, repeated keys, and a round trip; any change to src/query.js makes it fail.

capabilities.name: movingAverage
capabilities.where: test/moving-average.test.js imports nothing from src; it asserts on its own local windowMean helper (test/moving-average.test.js:8), so deleting src/movingAverage.js leaves the suite passing.

capabilities.name: backoff
capabilities.where: the tests live in test/backoff.spec.js, which the test script glob "test/*.test.js" in package.json:14 does not match, so npm test never runs them.

capabilities.name: bytes
capabilities.where: test/bytes.test.js runs but asserts nothing real: line 8 compares a value to itself, line 12 compares two identical calls, line 23 is assert.ok(true), and the third test only logs.
